events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war shows no signs of slowing down, with the US and its allies involved in the conflict. The war has significant implications for global markets, particularly oil prices. The conflict is expected to continue, with potential for further escalation.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The ongoing conflict in Iran is expected to lead to increased volatility in the markets, particularly in the oil and gas sector. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is a good buy as it provides broad exposure to the US market, while the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) is a good short as the conflict may lead to decreased demand for oil and gas.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if the conflict shows signs of de-escalation or if the oil prices stabilize
